defaultVoicemailPinEnabled.description: Set to `true` to enable the default voicemail passcode.

enabled.description: Set to `true` to expire passcode after the number of days specified.

numberOfDays.description: Number of days for password expiry. The minimum value is 15. The maximum value is 100.

enabled.description: Set to `true` to change the minimum number of days between passcode changes.

numberOfDays.description: Number of days between passcode changes. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is 7.

enabled.description: Set to `true` to specify how many of the previous passcode are not allowed to be re-used.

numberOfPasscodes.description: Number of previous passcodes. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is 10.
